name: Vietnam Open
stakes: This week at the Vietnam Open presents a golden opportunity for India to clinch a Super 100 title, with Isharani Baruah leading the charge in the women's singles final and HS Prannoy pushing for a spot in the men's singles summit clash.
summary:
India's contingent at the Vietnam Open has delivered a compelling performance, particularly in the women's singles draw, where three shuttlers—Isharani Baruah, Tanvi Sharma, and Rakshitha—stormed into the semifinals. Third seed Isharani Baruah has been a standout, triumphing over compatriot Rakshitha in a 21-10, 21-18 semifinal clash to reach her first BWF Tour final of the season, a significant milestone after her third-place finish at the Orleans Masters.

While Tanvi Sharma's impressive run concluded in the semifinals with a loss to Sarunrak Vitidsarn, and Rakshitha's surprise journey ended against Baruah, their deep runs underscore the emerging talent in India's women's singles circuit. In the men's singles, veteran HS Prannoy continues his campaign, reaching the semifinals where he is set to face Teh Jia Heng Jason, aiming to secure his first World Tour final of the season. Malvika Bansod, another promising talent, saw her tournament end in the quarterfinals, falling to compatriot Tanvi Sharma.
